name: @inid/server
description: Sign-in with InID for any server with web Requests and Responses (Astro, SvelteKit, Remix, React Router, Hono, Nuxt, Bun, Deno) and Express: the sign-in routes, a fresh session, and paths protected by role or permission.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.ts src/express.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --external:node:* --outdir=dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc src/index.ts src/express.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck --types node
